name: TouchDeck
description: Independent touchscreen dashboard, PipeWire mixer and MPRIS remote for KDE
permissions: Read installed XDG desktop application entries and launch applications selected by the user
Read and control user audio devices and application streams through the local PulseAudio-compatible server
Read and control MPRIS players on the session D-Bus; read local album artwork
Request confirmed session and power actions through login1 on the system D-Bus
Read user-accessible CPU, memory, disk, network and temperature statistics; optionally invoke nvidia-smi and nmcli for status
Store configuration and backups in XDG_CONFIG_HOME/touchdeck and logs in XDG_STATE_HOME/touchdeck
Optionally create or remove only TouchDeck's marked user autostart entry under XDG_CONFIG_HOME/autostart
Execute visible user-configured argument lists after confirmation; open user-configured URLs and files
